summary: Learn Stata survey setup, weighted estimates and reporting through applied exercises. Review the course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: Survey data analysis in Stata helps analysts, research officers and monitoring specialists prepare survey files and produce estimates they can explain. You’ll practise checking and recoding data, defining weights, strata and clusters with svyset, calculating design-aware means, proportions and totals, comparing subgroups, and documenting repeatable do-files and findings with appropriate cautions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, analyse or report survey data and need a reliable Stata workflow. It suits new Stata users and colleagues who use survey estimates in programme, research or operational decisions.
audience: Programme Managers using survey findings to review
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with tabular data and descriptive statistics is useful. No prior Stata experience is assumed; survey design information such as weights, strata and cluster identifiers will be used in the exercises. A computer with access to Stata is needed for hands-on practice.
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
